battlePass/buy/desc.en: The purchase of the "Battle Pass" allows to collect rewards from all opened levels of the Season. "Battle Pass" levels contain regular or unique prizes, including premium vehicles, camouflages, decorations, decals and profile icons. You can earn prizes by playing random battles and completing Battle Tasks and Season's Challenges.
